acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Both ADL subjects are pinned by exact source revision and executable SHA-256, and the v2 identity also binds selector generation, lock digest, and current-main ancestry
AC-2: The exact merged #5337 corpus bundle and all retained v1 evidence envelopes, portable stream hashes, repetitions, required fragments, and normalization derivations verify before comparison
AC-3: Every one of 25 cases, 23 behaviors, two equivalence groups, and one difference group has a deterministic v1/v2 result at the same accepted revision
AC-4: Normalization is limited to reviewed #5337 rules and cannot discard exits, arrays, diagnostics, identities, signature verdicts, sequential order, or a real semantic difference
AC-5: Every case has exactly one of exact_match, normalized_match, approved_intentional_difference, regression_blocker, unsupported_blocker, or evidence_invalid, with zero unknown or deferred rows
AC-6: Every approved intentional difference links a reviewed owner decision, rationale, replacement proof, risk, reviewer, and rollback impact; all other mismatches block

AC-7: Runtime v3 overlay binds exact terminal evidence for all ten proof groups from #5591/#5592/#5589/#5590/#5341/#5349 and grants no credit to fixture-, metadata-, library-, fixed-bootstrap-, degraded-, or Runtime-v2-reuse proof
AC-8: WP-10A overlay binds terminal #5497 convergence and live #5501 proof without inferring behavior from issue closure alone
AC-9: Required comparison, overlay, budget, strict-lint, dependency, test-count, deterministic rerun, no-network, and exact-review lanes all pass with no acceptance deferral

AC-10: WP-11 changes no product, Runtime v2, selector, default, cutover, deletion, AWS, credential, or publication state during preparation, and future completion authorizes only the #5361 acceptance input

steps.action: Complete six typed cards, exact corpus/runtime/WP-10A design, diagram, preparation validator, COTS/budget/PVF contract, review, bind, doctor, commit, and push without product execution
After all dependency receipts and ancestry pass, capture immutable ADL v1/v2 and dependency identities and independently verify the corpus and retained evidence

invariants: The #5337 corpus is immutable input and every machine-authoritative case remains mandatory
Both subjects and every dependency proof are exact-revision and digest bound
Normalization never hides semantic, ordering, diagnostic, exit, or signature differences
No mismatch is silently ignored or deferred
Runtime and WP-10A overlays preserve their owners and cannot compensate for an ADL corpus blocker
Preparation changes issue-local lifecycle paths only and leaves main/product/Runtime v2 untouched
risks: A moving ADL v2 binary or selector can make a comparison irreproducible
Overbroad normalization can turn a regression into a false match
Intentional-difference language can become an unreviewed waiver
Runtime fixture or metadata evidence can be mistaken for live production-component parity
Issue closure can be mistaken for terminal typed proof and ancestry
A new comparator can duplicate the mature #5337 harness and grow unnecessary code
stop_conditions: Any direct dependency is not merged, typed closed_out, retained by receipt, and ancestral to the comparison revision
Either executable, source revision, selector identity, lock digest, corpus bundle, or evidence envelope cannot be verified
A command shape, environment input, network route, credential, or normalization rule is undeclared
Any case, behavior, comparison group, Runtime proof group, WP-10A proof, or mismatch disposition is missing
A mismatch lacks an allowed reviewed disposition or any required lane would be deferred
Product, Runtime v2, default selector, AWS, cutover, deletion, or publication work would be required
